                        comment_line, block_end_line, "kept", fields, field_texts,
                    ))
                continue
        i += 1

    for beacon in beacons:
        if beacon.get("kind") != "span":
            continue

        b_id = (beacon.get("id") or "").strip()
        if not b_id:
            continue

        comment_line = beacon.get("comment_line")
        if not isinstance(comment_line, int) or not (1 <= comment_line <= n):
            continue

        j = comment_line
        open_end = comment_line
        while j <= n:
            raw = lines[j - 1].lstrip()
            if raw.startswith("--"):
                body = raw.lstrip("-").lstrip()
            else:
                body = raw
            if body.strip().startswith("]"):
                open_end = j
                break
            j += 1

        close_comment_line = None
        k = open_end + 1
        while k <= n:
            raw = lines[k - 1].lstrip()
            if raw.startswith("--"):
                body = raw.lstrip("-").lstrip()
            else:
                body = raw

            if "@beacon-close[" in body:
                close_lines = [body]
                k += 1
                while k <= n:
                    next_raw = lines[k - 1].lstrip()
                    if next_raw.startswith("--"):
                        next_body = next_raw.lstrip("-").lstrip()
                    else:
                        next_body = next_raw
                    close_lines.append(next_body)
                    if next_body.strip().startswith("]"):
                        k += 1
                        break
                    k += 1

                close_id = None
                for cl in close_lines:
                    cl = cl.strip()
                    if cl.startswith("id="):
                        close_id = cl.split("=", 1)[1].strip().strip(",").strip("]")
                        break

                if diagnostics is not None:
                    diagnostics.append(
                        {"record": "close", "line": k - len(close_lines), "id": close_id}
                    )
                if close_id == b_id:
                    close_comment_line = k - len(close_lines)
                    if diagnostics is not None:
                        diagnostics.append(
                            {"record": "close_match", "line": close_comment_line, "opener_line": comment_line}
                        )
                    break

            k += 1

        if close_comment_line is not None:
            inner_start = open_end + 1
            inner_end = close_comment_line - 1
            if inner_start <= inner_end:
                beacon["span_lineno_start"] = inner_start
                beacon["span_lineno_end"] = inner_end

    return beacons


def parse_js_beacon_blocks(
    lines: list[str], *, diagnostics: list | None = None
) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    beacons: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
    n = len(lines)
    i = 0

    def _strip_js_comment_sugar(text: str) -> str:
        t = text.lstrip()
        if t.startswith("//"):
            t = t[2:].lstrip()
        if t.startswith("/*"):
            t = t[2:].lstrip()
        if t.startswith("*/"):
            t = t[2:].lstrip()
        if t.startswith("*"):
            t = t[1:].lstrip()
        if t.endswith("*/"):
            t = t[:-2].rstrip()
        return t

    while i < n:
        line = lines[i]
        if "@beacon[" in line:
            comment_line = i + 1
            block_lines = [line]
            i += 1
            block_end_line = None
            while i < n:
                block_lines.append(lines[i])
                if _strip_js_comment_sugar(lines[i]).strip().startswith("]"):
                    block_end_line = i + 1
                    i += 1
                    break
                i += 1

            field_texts: list[str] = []
            inner_lines = block_lines[1:-1] if len(block_lines) >= 2 else []
            for raw in inner_lines:
                text = raw.strip()
                if not text:
                    continue
                text = _strip_js_comment_sugar(text)
                if not text or text.startswith("@beacon"):
                    continue
                field_texts.append(text)
            fields: dict[str, str] = parse_beacon_field_lines(field_texts)

            kind_raw = fields.get("kind")
            kind = (kind_raw or "span").strip().lower() or "span"
            if kind not in {"ast", "span"}:
                if diagnostics is not None:
                    diagnostics.append(_beacon_block_diagnostic(
                        comment_line, block_end_line, "skipped_unknown_kind", fields, field_texts,
                    ))
                continue

            show_span, show_span_explicit = _parse_show_span_fields(fields)

            beacon = {
                "id": fields.get("id"),
                "role": fields.get("role"),
                "slice_labels": fields.get("slice_labels"),
                "kind": kind,
                "start_snippet": fields.get("start_snippet"),
                "end_snippet": fields.get("end_snippet"),
                "comment": (fields.get("comment") if fields.get("comment") not in (None, "") else fields.get("comments")),
                "comment_line": comment_line,
                "kind_explicit": bool(kind_raw),
                "show_span": show_span,
                "show_span_explicit": show_span_explicit,
            }
            beacons.append(beacon)
            if diagnostics is not None:
                diagnostics.append(_beacon_block_diagnostic(
                    comment_line, block_end_line, "kept", fields, field_texts,
                ))
        else:
            i += 1

    for beacon in beacons:
        if beacon.get("kind") != "span":
            continue

        if beacon.get("span_lineno_start") is not None and beacon.get("span_lineno_end") is not None:
            continue

        b_id = (beacon.get("id") or "").strip()
        if not b_id:
            continue

        comment_line = beacon.get("comment_line")
        if not isinstance(comment_line, int) or not (1 <= comment_line <= n):
            continue

        j = comment_line
        open_end = comment_line
        while j <= n:
            raw = lines[j - 1]
            body = _strip_js_comment_sugar(raw)
            if body.strip().startswith("]"):
                open_end = j
                break
            j += 1

        close_comment_line = None
        k = open_end + 1
        while k <= n:
            raw = lines[k - 1]
            body = _strip_js_comment_sugar(raw)
            if "@beacon-close[" in body:
                close_lines = [body]
                k += 1
                while k <= n:
                    next_raw = lines[k - 1]
                    next_body = _strip_js_comment_sugar(next_raw)
                    close_lines.append(next_body)
                    if next_body.strip().startswith("]"):
                        k += 1
                        break
                    k += 1

                close_id = None
                for cl in close_lines:
                    text = cl.strip()
                    while text and text[-1] in ",]":
                        text = text[:-1].rstrip()
                    if text.startswith("id="):
                        _, val = text.split("=", 1)
                        close_id = val.strip()
                        break

                if diagnostics is not None:
                    diagnostics.append(
                        {"record": "close", "line": k - len(close_lines), "id": close_id}
                    )
                if close_id == b_id:
                    close_comment_line = k - len(close_lines)
                    if diagnostics is not None:
                        diagnostics.append(
                            {"record": "close_match", "line": close_comment_line, "opener_line": comment_line}
                        )
                    break

            k += 1

        if close_comment_line is not None:
            inner_start = open_end + 1
            inner_end = close_comment_line - 1
            if inner_start <= inner_end:
                beacon["span_lineno_start"] = inner_start
                beacon["span_lineno_end"] = inner_end

    return beacons


def parse_sh_beacon_blocks(
    lines: list[str], *, diagnostics: list | None = None
) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    beacons: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
    i = 0
    n = len(lines)
    while i < n:
        line = lines[i]
        stripped = line.lstrip()
        if stripped.startswith("#"):
            body = stripped.lstrip("#").lstrip()
            if body.startswith("@beacon["):
                comment_line = i + 1
                block_lines = [body]
                i += 1
                block_end_line = None
                while i < n:
                    next_line = lines[i].lstrip()
                    if next_line.startswith("#"):
                        next_body = next_line.lstrip("#").lstrip()
                    else:
                        next_body = next_line
                    block_lines.append(next_body)
                    if next_body.strip().startswith("]"):
                        block_end_line = i + 1
                        i += 1
                        break
                    i += 1

                field_texts: list[str] = []
                inner_lines = block_lines[1:-1] if len(block_lines) >= 2 else []
                for raw in inner_lines:
                    text = raw.strip()
                    if not text or text.startswith("@beacon"):
                        continue
                    field_texts.append(text)
                fields: dict[str, str] = parse_beacon_field_lines(field_texts)

                kind = (fields.get("kind") or "span").strip().lower() or "span"
                if kind not in {"ast", "span"}:
                    if diagnostics is not None:
                        diagnostics.append(_beacon_block_diagnostic(
                            comment_line, block_end_line, "skipped_unknown_kind", fields, field_texts,
                        ))
                    continue

                show_span, show_span_explicit = _parse_show_span_fields(fields)

                beacon = {
                    "id": fields.get("id"),
                    "role": fields.get("role"),
                    "slice_labels": fields.get("slice_labels"),
                    "kind": kind,
                    "start_snippet": fields.get("start_snippet"),
                    "end_snippet": fields.get("end_snippet"),
                    "comment": (fields.get("comment") if fields.get("comment") not in (None, "") else fields.get("comments")),
                    "comment_line": comment_line,
                    "show_span": show_span,
                    "show_span_explicit": show_span_explicit,
                }
                beacons.append(beacon)
                if diagnostics is not None:
                    diagnostics.append(_beacon_block_diagnostic(
                        comment_line, block_end_line, "kept", fields, field_texts,
                    ))
                continue
        i += 1

    for beacon in beacons:
        if beacon.get("kind") != "span":
            continue

        b_id = (beacon.get("id") or "").strip()
        if not b_id:
            continue

        comment_line = beacon.get("comment_line")
        if not isinstance(comment_line, int) or not (1 <= comment_line <= n):
            continue

        j = comment_line
        open_end = comment_line
        while j <= n:
            raw = lines[j - 1].lstrip()
            if raw.startswith("#"):
                body = raw.lstrip("#").lstrip()
            else:
                body = raw
            if body.strip().startswith("]"):
                open_end = j
                break
            j += 1

        close_comment_line = None
        k = open_end + 1
        while k <= n:
            raw = lines[k - 1].lstrip()
            if raw.startswith("#"):
                body = raw.lstrip("#").lstrip()
            else:
                body = raw

            if "@beacon-close[" in body:
                close_lines = [body]
                k += 1
                while k <= n:
                    next_raw = lines[k - 1].lstrip()
                    if next_raw.startswith("#"):
                        next_body = next_raw.lstrip("#").lstrip()
                    else:
                        next_body = next_raw
                    close_lines.append(next_body)
                    if next_body.strip().startswith("]"):
                        k += 1
                        break
                    k += 1

                close_id = None
                for cl in close_lines:
                    cl = cl.strip()
                    if cl.startswith("id="):
                        close_id = cl.split("=", 1)[1].strip().strip(",").strip("]")
                        break

                if diagnostics is not None:
                    diagnostics.append(
                        {"record": "close", "line": k - len(close_lines), "id": close_id}
                    )
                if close_id == b_id:
                    close_comment_line = k - len(close_lines)
                    if diagnostics is not None:
                        diagnostics.append(
                            {"record": "close_match", "line": close_comment_line, "opener_line": comment_line}
                        )
                    break

            k += 1

        if close_comment_line is not None:
            inner_start = open_end + 1
            inner_end = close_comment_line - 1
            if inner_start <= inner_end:
                beacon["span_lineno_start"] = inner_start
                beacon["span_lineno_end"] = inner_end

    return beacons


def parse_yaml_beacon_blocks(
    lines: list[str], *, diagnostics: list | None = None
) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    beacons: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
    i = 0
    n = len(lines)
    while i < n:
        line = lines[i]
        stripped = line.lstrip()
        if stripped.startswith("#"):
            body = stripped.lstrip("#").lstrip()
            if body.startswith("@beacon["):
                comment_line = i + 1
                block_lines = [body]
                i += 1
                block_end_line = None
                while i < n:
                    next_line = lines[i].lstrip()
                    if next_line.startswith("#"):
                        next_body = next_line.lstrip("#").lstrip()
                    else:
                        next_body = next_line
                    block_lines.append(next_body)
                    if next_body.strip().startswith("]"):
                        block_end_line = i + 1
                        i += 1
                        break
                    i += 1

                field_texts: list[str] = []
                inner_lines = block_lines[1:-1] if len(block_lines) >= 2 else []
                for raw in inner_lines:
                    text = raw.strip()
                    if not text or text.startswith("@beacon"):
                        continue
                    field_texts.append(text)
                fields: dict[str, str] = parse_beacon_field_lines(field_texts)

                kind = (fields.get("kind") or "span").strip().lower() or "span"
                if kind not in {"ast", "span"}:
                    if diagnostics is not None:
                        diagnostics.append(_beacon_block_diagnostic(
                            comment_line, block_end_line, "skipped_unknown_kind", fields, field_texts,
                        ))
                    continue

                show_span, show_span_explicit = _parse_show_span_fields(fields)

                beacon = {
                    "id": fields.get("id"),
                    "role": fields.get("role"),
                    "slice_labels": fields.get("slice_labels"),
                    "kind": kind,
                    "start_snippet": fields.get("start_snippet"),
                    "end_snippet": fields.get("end_snippet"),
                    "comment": (fields.get("comment") if fields.get("comment") not in (None, "") else fields.get("comments")),
                    "comment_line": comment_line,
                    "show_span": show_span,
                    "show_span_explicit": show_span_explicit,
                }
                beacons.append(beacon)
                if diagnostics is not None:
                    diagnostics.append(_beacon_block_diagnostic(
                        comment_line, block_end_line, "kept", fields, field_texts,
                    ))
                continue
        i += 1

    for beacon in beacons:
        if beacon.get("kind") != "span":
            continue

        b_id = (beacon.get("id") or "").strip()
        if not b_id:
            continue

        comment_line = beacon.get("comment_line")
        if not isinstance(comment_line, int) or not (1 <= comment_line <= n):
            continue

        j = comment_line
        open_end = comment_line
        while j <= n:
            raw = lines[j - 1].lstrip()
            if raw.startswith("#"):
                body = raw.lstrip("#").lstrip()
            else:
                body = raw
            if body.strip().startswith("]"):
                open_end = j
                break
            j += 1

        close_comment_line = None
        k = open_end + 1
        while k <= n:
            raw = lines[k - 1].lstrip()
            if raw.startswith("#"):
                body = raw.lstrip("#").lstrip()
            else:
                body = raw

            if "@beacon-close[" in body:
                close_lines = [body]
                k += 1
                while k <= n:
                    next_raw = lines[k - 1].lstrip()
                    if next_raw.startswith("#"):
                        next_body = next_raw.lstrip("#").lstrip()
                    else:
                        next_body = next_raw
                    close_lines.append(next_body)
                    if next_body.strip().startswith("]"):
                        k += 1
                        break
                    k += 1

                close_id = None
                for cl in close_lines:
                    cl = cl.strip()
                    if cl.startswith("id="):
                        close_id = cl.split("=", 1)[1].strip().strip(",").strip("]")
                        break

                if diagnostics is not None:
                    diagnostics.append(
                        {"record": "close", "line": k - len(close_lines), "id": close_id}
                    )
                if close_id == b_id:
                    close_comment_line = k - len(close_lines)
                    if diagnostics is not None:
                        diagnostics.append(
                            {"record": "close_match", "line": close_comment_line, "opener_line": comment_line}
                        )
                    break

            k += 1

        if close_comment_line is not None:
            inner_start = open_end + 1
            inner_end = close_comment_line - 1
            if inner_start <= inner_end:
                beacon["span_lineno_start"] = inner_start
                beacon["span_lineno_end"] = inner_end

    return beacons


def _extract_sql_beacon_context(
    lines: list[str],
    comment_line: int,
    beacon_id: Optional[str] = None,
) -> List[str]:
    context: List[str] = []

    n = len(lines)
    def _sql_body(raw_line: str) -> str:
        s = raw_line.lstrip()
        if s.startswith("--"):
            return s[2:].lstrip()
        return s
    def _is_meta_block_end(body: str) -> bool:
        return body.strip().startswith("]")

    comment_mask: list[bool] = [False] * n
    cleaned: list[str] = ["" for _ in range(n)]
    in_block = False

    for idx, raw in enumerate(lines, start=1):
        stripped = raw.lstrip()
        if not stripped:
            continue
        if "@beacon" in stripped:
            continue

        is_comment = False
        text = ""

        if not in_block:
            if stripped.startswith("--"):
                is_comment = True
                text = stripped[2:].lstrip()
            elif "/*" in stripped:
                is_comment = True
                in_block = True
                after = stripped.split("/*", 1)[1]
                if "*/" in after:
                    before_close, _ = after.split("*/", 1)
                    text = before_close.strip()
                    in_block = False
                else:
                    text = after.strip()
        else:
            is_comment = True
            if "*/" in stripped:
                before_close, _ = stripped.split("*/", 1)
                text = before_close.strip()
                in_block = False
            else:
                text = stripped

        if is_comment:
            comment_mask[idx - 1] = True
            cleaned[idx - 1] = text

    j = comment_line
    block_end = comment_line
    while j <= n:
        body = _sql_body(lines[j - 1])
        if _is_meta_block_end(body):
            block_end = j
            break
        j += 1

    j = comment_line - 1
    while j >= 1:
        raw = lines[j - 1]
        if not raw.strip():
            j -= 1
            continue
        if comment_mask[j - 1]:
            if cleaned[j - 1]:
                context.insert(0, cleaned[j - 1])
            j -= 1
            continue
        break

    j = block_end + 1
    while j <= n:
        raw = lines[j - 1]
        if not raw.strip():
            j += 1
            continue
        body = _sql_body(raw)
        if body.startswith("@beacon["):
            j += 1
            while j <= n:
                inner_body = _sql_body(lines[j - 1])
                if _is_meta_block_end(inner_body):
                    j += 1
                    break
                j += 1
            continue
        if body.startswith("@beacon-close["):
            close_id: Optional[str] = None
            j += 1
            while j <= n:
                inner_body = _sql_body(lines[j - 1]).strip()
                if inner_body.startswith("id=") and close_id is None:
                    close_id = inner_body.split("=", 1)[1].strip()
                    close_id = close_id.rstrip(",").rstrip("]").strip()
                if _is_meta_block_end(inner_body):
                    j += 1
                    break
                j += 1
            if beacon_id and close_id and close_id != beacon_id:
                continue
            break
        if comment_mask[j - 1]:
            if cleaned[j - 1]:
                context.append(cleaned[j - 1])
            j += 1
            continue
        break

    return _strip_beacon_meta_blocks_from_context(context)


def apply_sql_beacons(
    lines: list[str],
    file_children: List[Dict[str, Any]],
    beacons: list[dict[str, Any]],
) -> None:
    if not beacons:
        return

    n = len(lines)
    _prepend_duplicate_beacon_id_warning_nodes(file_children, beacons, language="SQL")

    for beacon in beacons:
        if beacon.get("kind") != "span":
            continue

        b_id = (beacon.get("id") or "").strip()
        role = (beacon.get("role") or "").strip()
        raw_slice_labels = (beacon.get("slice_labels") or "").strip()

        if not role and b_id and "@" in b_id:
            role = b_id.split("@", 1)[0]
        slice_labels = _canonicalize_slice_labels(raw_slice_labels, role)

        show_span, show_span_explicit = _beacon_show_span(beacon)

        display_role = strip_leading_decoration_symbols(role) or b_id or "sql-span-beacon"
        display_slice = slice_labels or "-"

        tag_suffix = _slice_label_tags(slice_labels or display_slice)
        name = f"🔱 {display_role}"
        if tag_suffix:
            name = f"{name} {tag_suffix}"

        context_lines = _extract_sql_beacon_context(
            lines,
            beacon.get("comment_line") or 0,
            beacon_id=b_id,
        )
        comment = strip_leading_decoration_symbols(beacon.get("comment"))

        note_lines = [
            "BEACON (SQL SPAN)",
            f"id: {b_id}",
            f"role: {role}",
            f"slice_labels: {slice_labels}",
            "kind: span",
        ]
        if show_span_explicit:
            note_lines.append(f"show_span: {'true' if show_span else 'false'}")
        if comment:
            note_lines.append(f"comment: {comment}")
        if context_lines:
            note_lines.append("")
            note_lines.append("CONTEXT COMMENTS (SQL):")
            note_lines.extend(context_lines)

        span_text_lines: List[str] = []
        span_start = beacon.get("span_lineno_start")
        span_end = beacon.get("span_lineno_end")
        if isinstance(span_start, int) and isinstance(span_end, int):
            span_start = max(1, span_start)
            span_end = min(n, span_end)
            if span_start <= span_end:
                span_text_lines = lines[span_start - 1 : span_end]
                while span_text_lines and not span_text_lines[0].strip():
                    span_text_lines.pop(0)
                while span_text_lines and not span_text_lines[-1].strip():
                    span_text_lines.pop()

        if show_span and span_text_lines:
            note_lines.append("")
            note_lines.append("SPAN TEXT:")
            note_lines.extend(span_text_lines)

        span_node = {
            "name": name,
            "note": "\n".join(note_lines),
            "children": [],
        }

        file_children.append(span_node)


def _extract_sh_beacon_context(
    lines: list[str],
    comment_line: int,
    beacon_id: Optional[str] = None,
) -> List[str]:
    n = len(lines)
    context: List[str] = []
    def _strip_hash_prefix(raw_line: str) -> str:
        s = raw_line.lstrip()
        if s.startswith("#"):
            return s[1:].lstrip()
        return s
    def _is_meta_block_end(body: str) -> bool:
        return body.strip().startswith("]")
    open_end = comment_line

    j = comment_line
    while 1 <= j <= n:
        body = _strip_hash_prefix(lines[j - 1])
        if _is_meta_block_end(body):
            open_end = j
            break
        j += 1

    j = comment_line - 1
    while j >= 1:
        raw = lines[j - 1]
        if not raw.strip():
            j -= 1
            continue
        stripped = raw.lstrip()
        if not stripped.startswith("#"):
            break
        body = _strip_hash_prefix(raw)
        if not body:
            j -= 1
            continue
        if body.startswith("@beacon") or _is_meta_block_end(body):
            break
        if set(body.strip()) <= {"#"}:
            j -= 1
            continue
        context.insert(0, body)
        j -= 1

    j = open_end + 1
    while j <= n:
        raw = lines[j - 1]
        if not raw.strip():
            j += 1
            continue
        stripped = raw.lstrip()
        if not stripped.startswith("#"):
            break
        body = _strip_hash_prefix(raw)
        if not body:
            j += 1
            continue
        if body.startswith("@beacon["):
            j += 1
            while j <= n:
                inner_body = _strip_hash_prefix(lines[j - 1])
                if _is_meta_block_end(inner_body):
                    j += 1
                    break
                j += 1
            continue
        if body.startswith("@beacon-close["):
            close_id: Optional[str] = None
            j += 1
            while j <= n:
                inner_body = _strip_hash_prefix(lines[j - 1]).strip()
                if inner_body.startswith("id=") and close_id is None:
                    close_id = inner_body.split("=", 1)[1].strip()
                    close_id = close_id.rstrip(",").rstrip("]").strip()
                if _is_meta_block_end(inner_body):
                    j += 1
                    break
                j += 1
            if beacon_id and close_id and close_id != beacon_id:
                continue
            break
        if body.startswith("@beacon"):
            break
        if set(body.strip()) <= {"#"}:
            j += 1
            continue
        context.append(body)
        j += 1

    return _strip_beacon_meta_blocks_from_context(context)


def _prepend_duplicate_beacon_id_warning_nodes(
    children: List[Dict[str, Any]],
    beacons: list[dict[str, Any]],
    *,
    language: str,
) -> None:
    if not beacons:
        return
    duplicate_beacon_ids = _duplicate_beacon_ids(beacons)
    if not duplicate_beacon_ids:
        return
    warning_nodes: List[Dict[str, Any]] = []
    for dup_id in duplicate_beacon_ids:
        warning_nodes.append(
            {
                "name": f"🚨 Duplicate beacon ID ({language}): {dup_id}",
                "note": (
                    "This file contains multiple @beacon blocks with the same id.\n\n"
                    "Why this matters:\n"
                    "- Blocks are matched by their id.\n"
                    "- Duplicate ids create ambiguous matches and may cause reorder storms.\n\n"
                    "Fix:\n"
                    "- Make beacon ids unique (or correct @beacon-close blocks).\n"
                    "- Then run the check again."
                ),
                "children": [],
                "_position_hint": "top",
            }
        )
    children[:0] = warning_nodes


def _duplicate_beacon_ids(beacons: list[dict[str, Any]]) -> list[str]:
    seen_beacon_ids: set[str] = set()
    duplicate_beacon_ids: set[str] = set()
    for b in beacons:
        bid = (b.get("id") or "").strip()
        if not bid:
            continue
        if bid in seen_beacon_ids:
            duplicate_beacon_ids.add(bid)
        seen_beacon_ids.add(bid)
    return sorted(duplicate_beacon_ids)


def apply_sh_beacons(
    lines: list[str],
    file_children: List[Dict[str, Any]],
    beacons: list[dict[str, Any]],
) -> None:
    if not beacons:
        return

    n = len(lines)
    _prepend_duplicate_beacon_id_warning_nodes(file_children, beacons, language="SH")

    for beacon in beacons:
        if beacon.get("kind") != "span":
            continue

        b_id = (beacon.get("id") or "").strip()
        role = (beacon.get("role") or "").strip()
        raw_slice_labels = (beacon.get("slice_labels") or "").strip()

        if not role and b_id and "@" in b_id:
            role = b_id.split("@", 1)[0]
        slice_labels = _canonicalize_slice_labels(raw_slice_labels, role)

        show_span, show_span_explicit = _beacon_show_span(beacon)

        display_role = strip_leading_decoration_symbols(role) or b_id or "sh-span-beacon"
        display_slice = slice_labels or "-"

        tag_suffix = _slice_label_tags(slice_labels or display_slice)
        name = f"🔱 {display_role}"
        if tag_suffix:
            name = f"{name} {tag_suffix}"

        context_lines = _extract_sh_beacon_context(
            lines,
            beacon.get("comment_line") or 0,
            beacon_id=b_id,
        )
        comment = strip_leading_decoration_symbols(beacon.get("comment"))

        note_lines = [
            "BEACON (SH SPAN)",
            f"id: {b_id}",
            f"role: {role}",
            f"slice_labels: {slice_labels}",
            "kind: span",
        ]
        if show_span_explicit:
            note_lines.append(f"show_span: {'true' if show_span else 'false'}")
        if comment:
            note_lines.append(f"comment: {comment}")
        if context_lines:
            note_lines.append("")
            note_lines.append("CONTEXT COMMENTS (SH):")
            note_lines.extend(context_lines)

        span_text_lines: List[str] = []
        span_start = beacon.get("span_lineno_start")
        span_end = beacon.get("span_lineno_end")
        if isinstance(span_start, int) and isinstance(span_end, int):
            span_start = max(1, span_start)
            span_end = min(n, span_end)
            if span_start <= span_end:
                span_text_lines = lines[span_start - 1 : span_end]
                while span_text_lines and not span_text_lines[0].strip():
                    span_text_lines.pop(0)
                while span_text_lines and not span_text_lines[-1].strip():
                    span_text_lines.pop()

        if show_span and span_text_lines:
            note_lines.append("")
            note_lines.append("SPAN TEXT:")
            note_lines.extend(span_text_lines)

        span_node = {
            "name": name,
            "note": "\n".join(note_lines),
            "children": [],
        }

        file_children.append(span_node)


def _extract_yaml_beacon_context(
    lines: list[str],
    comment_line: int,
    beacon_id: Optional[str] = None,
) -> List[str]:
    n = len(lines)
    context: List[str] = []
    def _strip_hash_prefix(raw_line: str) -> str:
        s = raw_line.lstrip()
        if s.startswith("#"):
            return s[1:].lstrip()
        return s
    def _is_meta_block_end(body: str) -> bool:
        return body.strip().startswith("]")
    open_end = comment_line

    j = comment_line
    while 1 <= j <= n:
        body = _strip_hash_prefix(lines[j - 1])
        if _is_meta_block_end(body):
            open_end = j
            break
        j += 1

    j = comment_line - 1
    while j >= 1:
        raw = lines[j - 1]
        if not raw.strip():
            j -= 1
            continue
        stripped = raw.lstrip()
        if not stripped.startswith("#"):
            break
        body = _strip_hash_prefix(raw)
        if not body:
            j -= 1
            continue
        if body.startswith("@beacon") or _is_meta_block_end(body):
            break
        if set(body.strip()) <= {"#"}:
            j -= 1
            continue
        context.insert(0, body)
        j -= 1

    j = open_end + 1
    while j <= n:
        raw = lines[j - 1]
        if not raw.strip():
            j += 1
            continue
        stripped = raw.lstrip()
        if not stripped.startswith("#"):
            break
        body = _strip_hash_prefix(raw)
        if not body:
            j += 1
            continue
        if body.startswith("@beacon["):
            j += 1
            while j <= n:
                inner_body = _strip_hash_prefix(lines[j - 1])
                if _is_meta_block_end(inner_body):
                    j += 1
                    break
                j += 1
            continue
        if body.startswith("@beacon-close["):
            close_id: Optional[str] = None
            j += 1
            while j <= n:
                inner_body = _strip_hash_prefix(lines[j - 1]).strip()
                if inner_body.startswith("id=") and close_id is None:
                    close_id = inner_body.split("=", 1)[1].strip()
                    close_id = close_id.rstrip(",").rstrip("]").strip()
                if _is_meta_block_end(inner_body):
                    j += 1
                    break
                j += 1
            if beacon_id and close_id and close_id != beacon_id:
                continue
            break
        if body.startswith("@beacon"):
            break
        if set(body.strip()) <= {"#"}:
            j += 1
            continue
        context.append(body)
        j += 1

    return _strip_beacon_meta_blocks_from_context(context)


def apply_yaml_beacons(
    lines: list[str],
    file_children: List[Dict[str, Any]],
    beacons: list[dict[str, Any]],
) -> None:
    if not beacons:
        return

    n = len(lines)
    _prepend_duplicate_beacon_id_warning_nodes(file_children, beacons, language="YAML")

    for beacon in beacons:
        if beacon.get("kind") != "span":
            continue

        b_id = (beacon.get("id") or "").strip()
        role = (beacon.get("role") or "").strip()
        raw_slice_labels = (beacon.get("slice_labels") or "").strip()

        if not role and b_id and "@" in b_id:
            role = b_id.split("@", 1)[0]
        slice_labels = _canonicalize_slice_labels(raw_slice_labels, role)

        show_span, show_span_explicit = _beacon_show_span(beacon)

        display_role = strip_leading_decoration_symbols(role) or b_id or "yaml-span-beacon"
        display_slice = slice_labels or "-"

        tag_suffix = _slice_label_tags(slice_labels or display_slice)
        name = f"🔱 {display_role}"
        if tag_suffix:
            name = f"{name} {tag_suffix}"

        context_lines = _extract_yaml_beacon_context(
            lines,
            beacon.get("comment_line") or 0,
            beacon_id=b_id,
        )
        comment = strip_leading_decoration_symbols(beacon.get("comment"))

        note_lines = [
            "BEACON (YAML SPAN)",
            f"id: {b_id}",
            f"role: {role}",
            f"slice_labels: {slice_labels}",
            "kind: span",
        ]
        if show_span_explicit:
            note_lines.append(f"show_span: {'true' if show_span else 'false'}")
        if comment:
            note_lines.append(f"comment: {comment}")
        if context_lines:
            note_lines.append("")
            note_lines.append("CONTEXT COMMENTS (YAML):")
            note_lines.extend(context_lines)

        span_text_lines: List[str] = []
        span_start = beacon.get("span_lineno_start")
        span_end = beacon.get("span_lineno_end")
        if isinstance(span_start, int) and isinstance(span_end, int):
            span_start = max(1, span_start)
            span_end = min(n, span_end)
            if span_start <= span_end:
                span_text_lines = lines[span_start - 1 : span_end]
                while span_text_lines and not span_text_lines[0].strip():
                    span_text_lines.pop(0)
                while span_text_lines and not span_text_lines[-1].strip():
                    span_text_lines.pop()

        if show_span and span_text_lines:
            note_lines.append("")
            note_lines.append("SPAN TEXT:")
            note_lines.extend(span_text_lines)

        span_node = {
            "name": name,
            "note": "\n".join(note_lines),
            "children": [],
        }

        file_children.append(span_node)


def apply_js_beacons(
    file_path: str,
    lines: list[str],
    outline_nodes: List[Dict[str, Any]],
    beacons: list[dict[str, Any]],
) -> None:
    if not beacons:
        return

    ast_nodes = list(_iter_ast_outline_nodes(outline_nodes))

    n = len(lines)
    _prepend_duplicate_beacon_id_warning_nodes(outline_nodes, beacons, language="JS/TS")

    def _js_next_anchor_line_after(line_no: int) -> Optional[int]:
        for idx in range(line_no + 1, n + 1):
            raw = lines[idx - 1]
            stripped = raw.lstrip()
            if not stripped:
                continue
            if stripped.startswith("//"):
                continue
            if stripped.startswith("/*") or stripped.startswith("*") or stripped.startswith("*/"):
                continue
            return idx
        return None

    def _header_line_for_node(node: dict[str, Any]) -> Optional[str]:
        ln = node.get("orig_lineno_start_unused")
        if not isinstance(ln, int) or ln <= 0 or ln > len(lines):
            return None
        return lines[ln - 1]

    span_sort_lines: dict[int, int] = {}

    def _node_source_order_line(node: dict[str, Any]) -> int:
        cached = span_sort_lines.get(id(node))
        if isinstance(cached, int):
            return cached
        ln = node.get("orig_lineno_start_unused") if isinstance(node, dict) else None
        if isinstance(ln, int):
            return ln
        return 10**9

    def _insert_child_in_source_order(
        siblings: List[Dict[str, Any]],
        child_node: Dict[str, Any],
        sort_line: int,
    ) -> None:
        span_sort_lines[id(child_node)] = sort_line
        insert_at = len(siblings)
        for idx, existing in enumerate(siblings):
            if _node_source_order_line(existing) > sort_line:
                insert_at = idx
                break
        siblings.insert(insert_at, child_node)

    def _extract_js_beacon_context(comment_line: int) -> List[str]:
        context: List[str] = []

        comment_mask: list[bool] = [False] * n
        cleaned: list[str] = ["" for _ in range(n)]
        in_block = False

        for idx, raw in enumerate(lines, start=1):
            stripped = raw.lstrip()
            if not stripped:
                continue

            is_comment = False
            text = ""

            if not in_block:
                if stripped.startswith("//"):
                    is_comment = True
                    text = stripped[2:].lstrip()
                elif "/*" in stripped:
                    is_comment = True
                    in_block = True
                    after = stripped.split("/*", 1)[1]
                    if "*/" in after:
                        before_close, _ = after.split("*/", 1)
                        text = before_close.strip()
                        in_block = False
                    else:
                        text = after.strip()
            else:
                is_comment = True
                if "*/" in stripped:
                    before_close, _ = stripped.split("*/", 1)
                    text = before_close.strip()
                    in_block = False
                else:
                    text = stripped

            if is_comment:
                comment_mask[idx - 1] = True
                cleaned[idx - 1] = text

        j = comment_line
        block_end = comment_line
        while j <= n:
            raw = lines[j - 1]
            body = raw.lstrip()
            if body.startswith("//"):
                body = body[2:].lstrip()
            if body.startswith("/*"):
                body = body[2:].lstrip()
            if body.startswith("*/"):
                body = body[2:].lstrip()
            if body.startswith("*"):
                body = body[1:].lstrip()
            if body.rstrip().endswith("*/"):
                body = body.rstrip()[:-2].rstrip()
            if body.strip().startswith("]"):
                block_end = j
                break
            j += 1

        j = comment_line - 1
        while j >= 1:
            raw = lines[j - 1]
            if not raw.strip():
                j -= 1
                continue
            if comment_mask[j - 1]:
                if cleaned[j - 1]:
                    context.insert(0, cleaned[j - 1])
                j -= 1
                continue
            break

        j = block_end + 1
        while j <= n:
            raw = lines[j - 1]
            if not raw.strip():
                j += 1
                continue
            if comment_mask[j - 1]:
                if cleaned[j - 1]:
                    context.append(cleaned[j - 1])
                j += 1
                continue
            break

        return _strip_beacon_meta_blocks_from_context(context)

    for beacon in beacons:
        kind = beacon.get("kind")
        start_snippet = beacon.get("start_snippet")
        b_id = beacon.get("id") or "(no-id)"
        if kind in {"span", "ast"} and not start_snippet:
            comment_line = beacon.get("comment_line") or 0
            if isinstance(comment_line, int) and comment_line > 0:
                anchor = _js_next_anchor_line_after(comment_line)
            else:
                anchor = None
            if anchor is None:
                continue
            beacon["_anchor_lineno"] = anchor

            if kind == "span" and isinstance(beacon.get("span_lineno_end"), int):
                continue

            if kind == "span" and bool(beacon.get("kind_explicit")):
                continue

            ast_candidates: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
            for node in ast_nodes:
                ast_type = node.get("ast_type")
                if ast_type not in {"class", "function", "method", "const_decl", "let_decl", "var_decl"}:
                    continue
                ln = node.get("orig_lineno_start_unused")
                if isinstance(ln, int) and ln == anchor:
                    ast_candidates.append(node)
            if kind == "span" and len(ast_candidates) == 1:
                beacon["kind"] = "ast"

    for beacon in beacons:
        if beacon.get("kind") != "ast":
            continue
        b_id = beacon.get("id") or "(no-id)"
        start_snippet = beacon.get("start_snippet")
        comment_line = beacon.get("comment_line") or 0
        anchor_lineno = beacon.get("_anchor_lineno")

        chosen: Optional[dict[str, Any]] = None

        if start_snippet:
            norm_snip = normalize_for_match(start_snippet)
            if not norm_snip:
                continue

            candidates: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
            for node in ast_nodes:
                header = _header_line_for_node(node)
                if header is None:
                    continue
                if norm_snip in normalize_for_match(header):
                    candidates.append(node)

            if not candidates:
                continue

            if len(candidates) == 1:
                chosen = candidates[0]
            else:
                after = [
                    n
                    for n in candidates
                    if isinstance(n.get("orig_lineno_start_unused"), int)
                    and n["orig_lineno_start_unused"] > comment_line
                ]
                if len(after) == 1:
                    chosen = after[0]
                else:
                    continue
        else:
            anchor = beacon.get("_anchor_lineno")
            if not isinstance(anchor, int):
                continue
            ast_candidates = [
                node
                for node in ast_nodes
                if node.get("ast_type") in {"class", "function", "method", "const_decl", "let_decl", "var_decl"}
                and isinstance(node.get("orig_lineno_start_unused"), int)
                and node["orig_lineno_start_unused"] == anchor
            ]
            if len(ast_candidates) == 1:
                chosen = ast_candidates[0]
            else:
                continue

        if not chosen:
            continue

        b_id = (beacon.get("id") or "").strip()
        role = (beacon.get("role") or "").strip()
        raw_slice_labels = (beacon.get("slice_labels") or "").strip()
        if not role and b_id and "@" in b_id:
            role = b_id.split("@", 1)[0]
        slice_labels = _canonicalize_slice_labels(raw_slice_labels, role)

        display_role = strip_leading_decoration_symbols(role) or b_id or "js-ast-beacon"
        display_slice = slice_labels or "-"
        tag_suffix = _slice_label_tags(slice_labels or display_slice)

        name = chosen.get("name") or "Untitled"
        if "🔱" not in name:
            name = f"{name} 🔱"
        if tag_suffix:
            name = f"{name} {tag_suffix}"
        chosen["name"] = name

        comment = strip_leading_decoration_symbols(beacon.get("comment"))
        meta_lines = [
            "BEACON (JS/TS AST)",
            f"id: {b_id}",
            f"role: {role}",
            f"slice_labels: {slice_labels}",
            "kind: ast",
        ]
        if comment:
            meta_lines.append(f"comment: {comment}")
        note = chosen.get("note") or ""
        if note:
            note_lines = note.splitlines()
            insert_idx = (
                1
                if (note_lines and note_lines[0].strip().startswith("AST_QUALNAME:"))
                else 0
            )
            new_note_lines: list[str] = []
            new_note_lines.extend(note_lines[:insert_idx])
            new_note_lines.extend(meta_lines)
            if insert_idx < len(note_lines):
                if note_lines[insert_idx].strip():
                    new_note_lines.append("")
                new_note_lines.extend(note_lines[insert_idx:])
            chosen["note"] = "\n".join(new_note_lines)
        else:
            chosen["note"] = "\n".join(meta_lines)

    for beacon in beacons:
        if beacon.get("kind") != "span":
            continue
        start_snippet = beacon.get("start_snippet")
        comment_line = beacon.get("comment_line") or 0

        attachment_line: Optional[int] = None

        if start_snippet:
            norm_snip = normalize_for_match(start_snippet)
            if not norm_snip:
                continue
            start_candidates: list[int] = []
            for idx, line in enumerate(lines, start=1):
                stripped = line.lstrip()
                if stripped.startswith("//") or stripped.startswith("/*") or stripped.startswith("*") or stripped.startswith("*/"):
                    continue
                if norm_snip in normalize_for_match(line):
                    start_candidates.append(idx)
            if not start_candidates:
                continue
            if len(start_candidates) == 1:
                attachment_line = start_candidates[0]
            else:
                after = [ln for ln in start_candidates if ln > comment_line]
                if len(after) == 1:
                    attachment_line = after[0]
                else:
                    continue
        else:
            span_start = beacon.get("span_lineno_start")
            if isinstance(span_start, int):
                attachment_line = span_start
            elif isinstance(comment_line, int) and comment_line > 0:
                attachment_line = comment_line
            else:
                anchor = beacon.get("_anchor_lineno")
                attachment_line = anchor if isinstance(anchor, int) else None

        if attachment_line is None:
            continue

        enclosing = _find_enclosing_ast_node_for_line(outline_nodes, attachment_line)

        b_id = (beacon.get("id") or "").strip()
        role = (beacon.get("role") or "").strip()
        raw_slice_labels = (beacon.get("slice_labels") or "").strip()
        if not role and b_id and "@" in b_id:
            role = b_id.split("@", 1)[0]
        slice_labels = _canonicalize_slice_labels(raw_slice_labels, role)

        show_span, show_span_explicit = _beacon_show_span(beacon)

        display_role = strip_leading_decoration_symbols(role) or b_id or "js-span-beacon"
        display_slice = slice_labels or "-"
        tag_suffix = _slice_label_tags(slice_labels or display_slice)

        name = f"🔱 {display_role}"
        if tag_suffix:
            name = f"{name} {tag_suffix}"

        context_lines = _extract_js_beacon_context(comment_line)
        comment = strip_leading_decoration_symbols(beacon.get("comment"))

        note_lines = [
            "BEACON (JS/TS SPAN)",
            f"id: {b_id}",
            f"role: {role}",
            f"slice_labels: {slice_labels}",
            "kind: span",
        ]
        if show_span_explicit:
            note_lines.append(f"show_span: {'true' if show_span else 'false'}")
        if comment:
            note_lines.append(f"comment: {comment}")
        if context_lines:
            note_lines.append("")
            note_lines.append("CONTEXT COMMENTS (JS/TS):")
            note_lines.extend(context_lines)

        span_start = beacon.get("span_lineno_start")
        span_end = beacon.get("span_lineno_end")
        span_text_lines: List[str] = []
        if isinstance(span_start, int) and isinstance(span_end, int):
            span_start = max(1, span_start)
            span_end = min(n, span_end)
            if span_start <= span_end:
                span_text_lines = lines[span_start - 1 : span_end]
                while span_text_lines and not span_text_lines[0].strip():
                    span_text_lines.pop(0)
                while span_text_lines and not span_text_lines[-1].strip():
                    span_text_lines.pop()

        if show_span and span_text_lines:
            note_lines.append("")
            note_lines.append("SPAN TEXT:")
            note_lines.extend(span_text_lines)

        span_node = {
            "name": name,
            "note": "\n".join(note_lines),
            "children": [],
            "orig_lineno_start_unused": attachment_line,
            "orig_lineno_end_unused": attachment_line,
        }

        if enclosing is not None:
            children = enclosing.get("children") or []
            _insert_child_in_source_order(children, span_node, attachment_line)
            enclosing["children"] = children
        else:
            _insert_child_in_source_order(outline_nodes, span_node, attachment_line)


def _token_is_pure_decoration(token: str) -> bool:
    if not token:
        return False
    return not any(ch.isalnum() for ch in token)


def split_name_and_tags(raw_name: str) -> tuple[str, list[str]]:
    name = (raw_name or "").strip()
    if not name:
        return "", []
    tokens = name.split()
    tags: list[str] = []
    trident = TRIDENT

    def _is_marker_decoration(tok: str) -> bool:
        t = tok.strip()
        return t == trident or t.startswith("\U0001FA9A")

    region_start = len(tokens)
    i = len(tokens) - 1
    while i >= 0:
        candidate = _strip_tag_underline_markup(tokens[i])
        if candidate.startswith("#") or _is_marker_decoration(candidate):
            region_start = i
            i -= 1
            continue
        if _token_is_pure_decoration(candidate):
            i -= 1
            continue
        break

    if region_start >= len(tokens):
        return name, []
    base = " ".join(tokens[:region_start]).strip()
    for tok in tokens[region_start:]:
        candidate = _strip_tag_underline_markup(tok)
        if candidate.startswith("#"):
            tags.append(candidate)
    return base, tags


def _indent_beacon_block(block_lines: list[str], source_lines: list[str], insert_idx: int) -> list[str]:
    indent = ""
    for idx in range(insert_idx, len(source_lines)):
        line = source_lines[idx]
        if line.strip():
            indent = line[:len(line) - len(line.lstrip())]
            break
    return [indent + line for line in block_lines]


_BEACON_EXTENT_LINE_PREFIX = {
    "python": "#",
    "js_ts": "//",
    "vue": "//",
    "sql": "--",
    "shell": "#",
    "yaml": "#",
}


def _beacon_block_extent_for_language(
    language: str,
    lines: list[str],
    beacon: dict,
) -> Optional[tuple[int, int]]:
    cl = beacon.get("comment_line")
    if not isinstance(cl, int) or cl <= 0 or cl > len(lines):
        return None
    if language == "markdown":
        start_idx = cl - 1
        j = cl - 1
        while j >= 1:
            raw = lines[j - 1]
            if "<!--" in raw:
                start_idx = j - 1
                break
            if raw.strip():
                break
            j -= 1
        end_idx = None
        j = cl
        while j <= len(lines):
            raw = lines[j - 1]
            if "-->" in raw:
                end_idx = j - 1
                break
            j += 1
        if end_idx is None:
            return None
        return start_idx, end_idx
    prefix = _BEACON_EXTENT_LINE_PREFIX.get(language)
    if prefix is None:
        return None
    start_idx = cl - 1
    end_idx = None
    j = cl
    while j <= len(lines):
        raw = lines[j - 1]
        stripped = raw.lstrip()
        body = stripped[len(prefix):].lstrip() if stripped.startswith(prefix) else stripped
        if body == "]":
            end_idx = j - 1
            break
        j += 1
    if end_idx is None:
        return None
    return start_idx, end_idx


def _python_decorator_ranges_by_definition(
    lines: list[str], *, tree: Optional[ast.AST] = None,
) -> dict[int, list[tuple[int, int]]]:
    import io
    import tokenize

    source = "\n".join(lines)
    try:
        if tree is None:
            tree = ast.parse(source)
        targets = [
            node for node in ast.walk(tree)
            if isinstance(node, (ast.ClassDef, ast.FunctionDef, ast.AsyncFunctionDef))
            and node.decorator_list
        ]
        if not targets:
            return {}

        candidates: list[tuple[int, int]] = []
        last_definition_line = max(node.lineno for node in targets)
        first = None
        for token in tokenize.generate_tokens(io.StringIO(source).readline):
            if token.start[0] >= last_definition_line:
                break
            if token.type in (tokenize.NL, tokenize.COMMENT, tokenize.INDENT, tokenize.DEDENT):
                continue
            if token.type == tokenize.NEWLINE:
                if first is not None and first.type == tokenize.OP and first.string == "@":
                    candidates.append((first.start[0] - 1, token.end[0] - 1))
                first = None
            elif first is None:
                first = token

        by_definition: dict[int, list[tuple[int, int]]] = {}
        for target in targets:
            ranges: list[tuple[int, int]] = []
            for decorator in target.decorator_list:
                owned = [
                    (start, end) for start, end in candidates
                    if start <= decorator.lineno - 1
                    and (decorator.end_lineno or decorator.lineno) - 1 <= end
                    and end < target.lineno - 1
                ]
                if len(owned) != 1 or owned[0] in ranges:
                    break
                ranges.append(owned[0])
            else:
                by_definition[target.lineno - 1] = ranges
        return by_definition
    except (SyntaxError, ValueError, tokenize.TokenError):
        return {}


def _build_beacon_block_for_language(
    language: str,
    *,
    bid: str,
    role: Optional[str],
    slice_labels: Optional[str],
    kind: Optional[str],
    show_span: Optional[bool],
    comment_text: Optional[str],
    start_snippet: Optional[str] = None,
    end_snippet: Optional[str] = None,
    section: Optional[str] = None,
) -> list[str]:
    style = language
    if language == "vue":
        style = {"template": "html", "style": "css", "script": "js_line"}.get(
            section or "script", "js_line"
        )
    elif language == "markdown":
        style = "html"
    elif language == "js_ts":
        style = "js_line"

    fields: list[tuple[str, str]] = []
    if role:
        fields.append(("role", str(role)))
    if slice_labels:
        fields.append(("slice_labels", str(slice_labels)))
    if kind:
        fields.append(("kind", str(kind)))
    if start_snippet:
        fields.append(("start_snippet", f'"{start_snippet}"'))
    if end_snippet:
        fields.append(("end_snippet", f'"{end_snippet}"'))
    if show_span is not None:
        fields.append(("show_span", "true" if show_span else "false"))
    if comment_text:
        fields.append(("comment", str(comment_text)))

    if style == "html":
        lines = ["<!--", "@beacon[", f"  id={bid},"]
        lines += [f"  {k}={v}," for k, v in fields]
        lines += ["]", "-->"]
        return lines
    if style == "css":
        lines = ["/* @beacon[", f"   id={bid},"]
        lines += [f"   {k}={v}," for k, v in fields]
        lines += ["] */"]
        return lines
    prefix = {"js_line": "//", "sql": "--"}.get(style) or (
        "--" if language == "sql" else "#"
    )
    lines = [f"{prefix} @beacon[", f"{prefix}   id={bid},"]
    lines += [f"{prefix}   {k}={v}," for k, v in fields]
    lines += [f"{prefix} ]"]
    return lines


def _find_beacon_close_block_extent(
    language: str,
    lines: list[str],
    bid: str,
    search_from_idx: int = 0,
) -> Optional[tuple[int, int]]:
    prefix = _BEACON_EXTENT_LINE_PREFIX.get(language)
    wanted = (bid or "").strip()
    if not wanted or (prefix is None and language != "markdown"):
        return None
    search_from_idx = max(0, search_from_idx)
    i = 0 if language == "markdown" else search_from_idx
    fence_char = ""
    fence_len = 0
    while i < len(lines):
        start_idx = i
        body = lines[i].lstrip()
        if language == "markdown":
            fm = re.match(r"^ {0,3}(`{3,}|~{3,})(.*)$", lines[i])
            if fm:
                run, suffix = fm.groups()
                if not fence_char:
                    fence_char, fence_len = run[0], len(run)
                elif run[0] == fence_char and len(run) >= fence_len and not suffix.strip():
                    fence_char, fence_len = "", 0
                i += 1
                continue
            if fence_char or not body.startswith("<!--"):
                i += 1
                continue
            body = body[4:]
            block = []
            j = i
            while j < len(lines):
                text, separator, suffix = body.partition("-->")
                block.append(text.strip())
                if separator:
                    break
                j += 1
                if j < len(lines):
                    body = lines[j]
            i = j + 1
            if j == len(lines) or suffix.strip() or start_idx < search_from_idx:
                continue
            end_idx = j
            block = [text for text in block if text]
            if not block or not block[0].startswith("@beacon-close["):
                continue
        else:
            if not body.startswith(prefix):
                i += 1
                continue
            body = body[len(prefix):].lstrip()
            if not body.startswith("@beacon-close["):
                i += 1
                continue
            block = [body]
            end_idx = None
            j = i + 1
            while j < len(lines):
                body = lines[j].lstrip()
                if not body.startswith(prefix):
                    break
                body = body[len(prefix):].strip()
                if body.startswith(("@beacon[", "@beacon-close[")):
                    break
                block.append(body)
                if body.startswith("]"):
                    end_idx = j
                    j += 1
                    break
                j += 1
            i = j
            if end_idx is None:
                continue

        found_id = None
        for k, body in enumerate(block[1:], start=1):
            if body.startswith("]"):
                if language == "markdown" and (body != "]" or k != len(block) - 1):
                    break
                if found_id == wanted:
                    return (start_idx, end_idx)
                break
            if body.startswith(("@beacon[", "@beacon-close[")):
                break
            text = body.strip()
            while text and text[-1] in ",]":
                text = text[:-1].rstrip()
            if text.startswith("id="):
                found_id = (
                    text.split("=", 1)[1].strip().strip('"').strip("'").strip()
                )
    return None


BYTES_PER_TOKEN_ESTIMATE = 3


def format_snippet_header(
    header_prefix: str,
    lines: Sequence[str],
    span_start: int,
    span_end: int,
    *,
    relative_start: int | None = None,
) -> str:
    total_lines = len(lines)
    span_length = span_end - span_start + 1
    byte_count = sum(
        len(line.encode("utf-8")) + 1 for line in lines[span_start - 1 : span_end]
    )
    token_estimate = -(-byte_count // BYTES_PER_TOKEN_ESTIMATE)
    header = (
        f"[{header_prefix}lines {span_start}-{span_end} of {total_lines} | "
        f"{span_length} lines, {byte_count} bytes, ~{token_estimate} tokens]"
    )
    if relative_start is not None:
        header = header[:-1] + f" | relative 1 = line {relative_start}]"
    return header


def clamp_span_to_head_tail(
    span_start: int, span_end: int, max_lines: int
) -> tuple[int, int, int, int, int]:
    tail = max_lines // 4
    head = max_lines - tail
    return (
        span_start + head - 1,
        span_end - tail + 1,
        span_start + head,
        span_end - tail,
        (span_end - span_start + 1) - max_lines,
    )


_TIER_FENCE_BACKTICK_RE = re.compile(r"^ {0,3}`{3,}")


_TIER_FENCE_TILDE_RE = re.compile(r"^ {0,3}~{3,}")


def _tier_fence_for(body_lines: Sequence[str]) -> str:
    if any(_TIER_FENCE_BACKTICK_RE.match(line) for line in body_lines):
        if not any(_TIER_FENCE_TILDE_RE.match(line) for line in body_lines):
            return "~~~~"
        return "`" * 12
    return "```"


POSTFIX_SEP = "--"


def slice_tag_variant_match(
    tag_stripped: str,
    prefix: str,
    *,
    postfix_words: Iterable[str],
) -> dict[str, Any] | None:
    if not tag_stripped or not prefix:
        return None
    if not tag_stripped.startswith(prefix):
        return None
    remainder = tag_stripped[len(prefix):]

    matched_postfix = ""
    middle = remainder
    for w in postfix_words:
        if not w:
            continue
        suf = POSTFIX_SEP + w
        if remainder.endswith(suf) and len(remainder) >= len(suf):
            matched_postfix = w
            middle = remainder[: -len(suf)]
            break

    if middle and not middle.startswith("-"):
        return None

    return {"matched_prefix": prefix, "middle": middle, "postfix": matched_postfix}


def parse_mapped_note(note: str) -> list[tuple[str, Any]]:
    if not isinstance(note, str) or not note:
        return []
    lines = note.splitlines()
    items: list[tuple[str, Any]] = []
    body_started = False
    i = 0
    n = len(lines)
    _block_keys = ("id", "role", "slice_labels", "kind", "show_span",
                   "comment", "comments")

    def _is_block_key(text: str) -> bool:
        head = re.split(r"[:=]", text, 1)[0].strip()
        return head in _block_keys

    while i < n:
        s = lines[i].strip()

        if s == "MD_PATH:" or s.startswith("MD_PATH:"):
            open_line = i
            i += 1
            found_sep_md = False
            while i < n:
                if lines[i].strip() == "---":
                    i += 1
                    found_sep_md = True
                    break
                i += 1
            if body_started:
                items.append(("md_path_body", lines[open_line:i]))
            else:
                block_end = (i - 1) if found_sep_md else i
                items.append(("md_path", lines[open_line + 1:block_end]))
                if found_sep_md:
                    _j = i
                    while _j < n and not lines[_j].strip():
                        _j += 1
                    if not (
                        _j < n
                        and (
                            lines[_j].strip().startswith("BEACON (")
                            or lines[_j].strip().startswith("@beacon[")
                        )
                    ):
                        body_started = True
            continue

        if s.startswith("AST_QUALNAME:"):
            if body_started:
                raw = [lines[i]]
                i += 1
                if i < n and lines[i].strip() == "---":
                    raw.append(lines[i])
                    i += 1
                items.append(("ast_qualname_body", raw))
                continue
            i += 1
            if i < n and lines[i].strip() == "---":
                _j = i + 1
                _beacon_flip = True
                while _j < n and not lines[_j].strip():
                    _j += 1
                if _j < n and (
                    lines[_j].strip().startswith("BEACON (")
                    or lines[_j].strip().startswith("@beacon[")
                ):
                    _k = _j + 1
                    _closer = -1
                    while _k < n:
                        _t = lines[_k].strip()
                        if _t == "---":
                            _closer = _k
                            break
                        if _t and not _is_block_key(_t):
                            _closer = _k
                            break
                        _k += 1
                    if _closer < 0:
                        _beacon_flip = False
                    else:
                        _closer_text = lines[_closer].strip()
                        if _closer_text == "---":
                            _beacon_flip = False
                        elif _closer_text in (")", "]"):
                            _after = _closer + 1
                            if _after < n and lines[_after].strip() == "---":
                                _beacon_flip = False
                            elif _after >= n:
                                _beacon_flip = False
                        else:
                            _beacon_flip = False
                i += 1
                if _beacon_flip:
                    body_started = True
            continue

        if s.startswith("BEACON (") or s.startswith("@beacon["):
            open_line = i
            i += 1
            found_sep = False
            record: dict[str, str] = {}
            while i < n:
                t = lines[i].strip()
                if t == "---":
                    i += 1
                    found_sep = True
                    break
                if t.startswith("comment:"):
                    record["comment"] = t.split(":", 1)[1].strip()
                elif t.startswith("comments:"):
                    record["comment"] = t.split(":", 1)[1].strip()
                if t and not any(
                    t.startswith(prefix)
                    for prefix in (
                        "id:",
                        "role:",
                        "slice_labels:",
                        "kind:",
                        "show_span:",
                        "comment:",
                        "comments:",
                    )
                ):
                    break
                if t.startswith("id:"):
                    record["id"] = t.split(":", 1)[1].strip()
                elif t.startswith("role:"):
                    record["role"] = t.split(":", 1)[1].strip()
                elif t.startswith("slice_labels:"):
                    record["slice_labels"] = t.split(":", 1)[1].strip()
                elif t.startswith("kind:"):
                    record["kind"] = t.split(":", 1)[1].strip()
                elif t.startswith("show_span:"):
                    record["show_span"] = t.split(":", 1)[1].strip()
                i += 1
            if found_sep:
                if i < n and not lines[i].strip():
                    i += 1
            if body_started:
                record["_raw_lines"] = lines[open_line:i]
                items.append(("beacon_body", record))
            else:
                items.append(("beacon", record))
                if found_sep:
                    body_started = True
            continue


        items.append(("line", lines[i]))
        if lines[i].strip():
            body_started = True
        i += 1
    return items


def _repository_view_span(text: str) -> str:
    longest = 0
    run = 0
    for ch in text:
        if ch == "`":
            run += 1
            if run > longest:
                longest = run
        else:
            run = 0
    fence = "`" * (longest + 1)
    pad = " " if (text.startswith("`") or text.endswith("`")) else ""
    return f"{fence}{pad}{text}{pad}{fence}"


REPOSITORY_VIEW_ENTRY_MARKERS = ("AST_QUALNAME:", "BEACON (", "MD_PATH:")


def repository_view_note_is_entry(note: str) -> bool:
    if not note:
        return False
    return note.split("\n", 1)[0].strip().startswith(REPOSITORY_VIEW_ENTRY_MARKERS)


def repository_view_section_title(
    items: list[tuple[str, Any]], strip_text: Callable[[str], str]
) -> str:
    for _kind, payload in items:
        if _kind != "md_path":
            continue
        hash_lines = [
            str(line).strip()
            for line in payload
            if str(line).strip().startswith("#")
        ]
        if hash_lines:
            title = hash_lines[-1].lstrip("#")
            if title.startswith(" "):
                title = title[1:]
            return strip_text(title).strip()
    return ""


def repository_view_body_parts(
    items: list[tuple[str, Any]], strip_text: Callable[[str], str]
) -> list[list[str]]:
    parts: list[list[str]] = []
    current: list[str] = []

    def _feed(raw_line: str) -> None:
        nonlocal current
        stripped = raw_line.strip()
        if stripped == "SPAN TEXT:" or re.fullmatch(
            r"CONTEXT COMMENTS \(.*\):", stripped
        ):
            if current:
                parts.append(current)
                current = []
            return
        current.append(raw_line)

    for kind, payload in items:
        if kind == "line":
            _feed(str(payload))
        elif kind == "ast_qualname_body":
            for _line in payload:
                _feed(str(_line))
        elif kind == "md_path_body":
            for _line in payload:
                _feed(str(_line))
        elif kind == "beacon_body":
            for _line in (payload.get("_raw_lines") or []):
                _feed(str(_line))
    if current:
        parts.append(current)
    trimmed: list[list[str]] = []
    for part in parts:
        while part and not part[0].strip():
            part.pop(0)
        while part and not part[-1].strip():
            part.pop()
        if part:
            trimmed.append([strip_text(line) for line in part])
    return trimmed


def repository_view_labels_and_comment(
    items: list[tuple[str, Any]], strip_text: Callable[[str], str]
) -> tuple[list[str], str]:
    beacon_records = [payload for kind, payload in items if kind == "beacon"]
    first_record = beacon_records[0] if beacon_records else {}
    raw_labels = first_record.get("slice_labels") or ""
    labels = (
        [t[1:] for t in _slice_label_tags(raw_labels).split()]
        if raw_labels
        else []
    )
    comment_text = strip_text(first_record.get("comment") or "").strip()
    return labels, comment_text


def repository_view_entry_display(
    name: str,
    note: str,
    parent_entry_kind: str | None,
    *,
    headings_only: bool,
    strip_text: Callable[[str], str],
) -> tuple[str, str]:

    items = parse_mapped_note(note)
    base, _tags = split_name_and_tags(str(name or ""))
    base = strip_text(base).strip()
    tokens = base.split()
    first = tokens[0] if tokens else ""
    rest = tokens[1:]

    labels, comment_text = repository_view_labels_and_comment(items, strip_text)

    marker = note.split("\n", 1)[0].strip()
    if marker.startswith("MD_PATH:"):
        title = repository_view_section_title(items, strip_text) or base or "section"
        heading = f"section {title}"
    elif marker.startswith("BEACON ("):
        title = " ".join(rest).strip() or "span-beacon"
        heading = f"region {_repository_view_span(title)}"
    elif first == EMOJI_CLASS:
        if rest and rest[0] in ("class", "interface", "type", "enum"):
            kind = rest[0]
            title = " ".join(rest[1:]).strip()
        else:
            kind = "class"
            title = " ".join(rest).strip()
        heading = f"{kind} {_repository_view_span(title)}"
    elif first == EMOJI_FUNC:
        if rest and rest[0] in ("function", "method", "const", "let", "var"):
            kind = rest[0]
            title = " ".join(rest[1:]).strip()
        elif parent_entry_kind in ("class", "interface"):
            kind = "method"
            title = " ".join(rest).strip()
        else:
            kind = "function"
            title = " ".join(rest).strip()
        heading = f"{kind} {_repository_view_span(title)}"
    elif first == EMOJI_ASYNC:
        if parent_entry_kind in ("class", "interface"):
            kind = "async method"
        else:
            kind = "async function"
        title = " ".join(rest).strip()
        heading = f"{kind} {_repository_view_span(title)}"
    elif first == EMOJI_CONST:
        heading = f"constant {_repository_view_span(' '.join(rest).strip())}"
    else:
        heading = f"symbol {_repository_view_span(base)}"

    pieces: list[str] = []
    if labels:
        pieces.append("Labels: " + ", ".join(labels))
    if comment_text:
        pieces.append(comment_text)
    if not headings_only:
        for part_lines in repository_view_body_parts(items, strip_text):
            fence = _tier_fence_for(part_lines)
            pieces.append(
                fence + "text\n" + "\n".join(part_lines) + "\n" + fence
            )
    body = "\n\n".join(pieces)
    return heading, body


def repository_view_heading_kind(heading: str) -> str | None:
    word = heading.split(" ", 1)[0] if heading else ""
    return word or None
